description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractSender' that extends 'AbstractHonoClient'. It provides functionalities for sending AMQP messages over a Vertx-Proton connection to a Hono server. The class manages message sending, spans for tracing, delivery outcomes, and external dependencies like ProtonSender, OpenTracing, and Vertx. It serves as a base class for concrete message sender implementations within the Hono client library.

classes.name: AbstractSender
classes.description: An abstract base class for message senders using AMQP with Vertx-Proton, supporting tracing and delivery semantics.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the current credit available for message sending from the ProtonSender.

methods.name: sendQueueDrainHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to be called when the sender's message queue has drained to allow more messages to be sent.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the sender and related links gracefully.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks whether the sender link is currently open.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message asynchronously with optional tracing context.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to send a message; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Creates and starts a new tracing span for message sending.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Creates and starts a new tracing span, optionally with a parent context.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Gets the destination address for messages.

methods.name: sendMessageAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for delivery success or failure, with timeout handling.

methods.name: logMessageIdAndSenderInfo
methods.description: Logs tracing information related to message ID and sender credits/QoS.

methods.name: logUpdatedDeliveryState
methods.description: Logs and updates the tracing span based on the delivery state received.
